questions.question: Can you explain the procedure and key considerations for conducting a statutory audit of inventory for a manufacturing company?
key_points: Observation of physical stock-taking
Valuation as per AS 2 or Ind AS 2 (Lower of Cost and Net Realizable Value)
Verification of cutoff procedures
Checking slow-moving and obsolete inventory

questions.question: What is the difference between Deferred Tax Asset (DTA) and Deferred Tax Liability (DTL) under AS 22, and how do timing differences arise?
key_points: Definition of timing differences between accounting income and taxable income
DTL arises when taxable income is less than accounting income
DTA arises when taxable income is greater than accounting income
Assessment of virtual certainty for recognition of DTA

questions.question: How would you verify revenue recognition for a software company that provides both annual maintenance contracts and customized development services?
key_points: Application of AS 9 or Ind AS 115 (Revenue from Contracts with Customers)
Percentage of completion method for customized development
Time-proportion basis for annual maintenance contracts
Unbilled revenue and deferred revenue adjustments

questions.question: What are the primary compliances and tax audit reporting requirements under Section 44AB of the Income Tax Act for a business with a turnover exceeding 10 crores?
key_points: Applicability of e-invoicing and digital transactions threshold
Reporting in Form 3CD with emphasis on clauses relating to GST reconciliation
Transfer pricing and domestic related-party transactions under Section 40A(2)(b)
TDS default reporting under Clause 21(b)

questions.question: Explain the concept of Internal Financial Controls (IFC) over financial reporting and your approach as an auditor in testing these controls in a company.
key_points: Understanding the design and implementation (D&I) of controls
Operating effectiveness testing through walkthroughs and sampling
Identifying significant deficiencies and material weaknesses
Reporting under Section 143(3)(i) of the Companies Act, 2013
